finding: H2 design_owner holds DocumentSession; newer M04 requires one common DocumentOwner. Both cannot own independent registries.
proposed_exact_amendment: M04 document_owner.rs owns exactly one session per project/document. M03 design_owner.rs is facade over owner token; writer transfer increments common generation, invalidates all M02/M03/M06/M07 plans tied to old generation. Content/history unchanged. No independent session initializer in facade.
blocked_scope: M03 runtime owner and all consumers until joint owner amendment

source_fields: M03 owner_binding.semantic_profile / M04 output_serialization / M07 capture_fingerprint
finding: Old H2 untagged JSON differs shared tagged decimal-value profile; raw payload/RECOVERY-FP hashes are distinct.
proposed_exact_amendment: SGA-DESIGN-SEM-v1 is sole proposed design semantic bytes; XML uses M04-EssXmlV1-semantic-v1. All consumers carry {profile,digest}; no cross-profile equality or baseline relabeling. M07 RECOVERY-FP wraps content semantic+asset/binding evidence and ACKs M04 original semantic only. Existing S1 hash APIs unchanged.

finding: Several DTOs use u64 JSON number while UI JS cannot represent all u64 exactly; M01 has decimal-string projection.
proposed_exact_amendment: All UI wire revisions/generations/sequences/byte sizes beyond safe range use canonical decimal STRING 0|[1-9][0-9]* ≤u64MAX; no leading plus/zero/space/exponent. HOST parses checked u64; JS retains strings/BigInt for compare. Internal Rust u64 unchanged. Persisted machine schema numbers remain their declared integer contract, not UI parse/re-serialize.
blocked_scope: All affected UI DTO transport; no domain migration

finding: M04 original receipt→ACK omits catalog root promotion required by newer M05.
proposed_exact_amendment: Save captures content/profile+exact assets→durable Save pin→file commit verified→durable formal-root transfer receipt→ACK captured revision+semantic. Transfer fail after file commit returns CommittedAckDeferred (stage=RetentionTransfer), keeps Held and original file receipt, never retries write blindly. Snapshot baseline untouched.
blocked_scope: Formal save integrated with material pins

finding: Pin schema Held|Transferred omits Released used by release flow; M06 adds Export purpose absent M05.
proposed_exact_amendment: PinState=Held|Transferred|Released. PinPurpose=Candidate|Save|Undo|Redo|Recovery|Import|Export. Only verified catalog transition updates state; Transferred/Released immutable terminal metadata. No TTL. Add matching operation results and strict decoder/negative fixtures; old product S1 untouched.
blocked_scope: M05 catalog schema/decoder and M06 Export pin

source_fields: M04 MaterialResolutionPort / M05 application_inputs / M07 M05_extension / M06 ports
finding: M04 resolve snapshot has root_proof_id; M05 snapshot lacks matching field; later export/import methods and signatures differ.
proposed_exact_amendment: Normalize app API: resolve(Context,Requests)->ResolutionSnapshot{context,catalog_generation,catalog_raw_digest,snapshot_digest,completeness,assets,bindings}; pin(snapshot,purpose,operation_id)->PinReceipt; validate_pin; read_pinned_version; import_verified_versions(context,verified_bundle,purpose,operation_id); transfer(pin,RootManifest,ExternalCommitProof,operation_id); release(pin,RootBundle,operation_id). Remove root_proof_id from resolve (root observation not asset resolution proof). Versioned receipt types below authoritative proposed overlay.
blocked_scope: Material import/export/resolve callers; real provider readiness

finding: M04 open needs M05, M05 binding identity might depend M03 owner, M07 root completeness needs future providers. Whole-module prerequisite would deadlock.
proposed_exact_amendment: M03-C1/M04 codec projectors pure HOST decode+typed entity/reference inventory before runtime owner install. M05 resolves asset IDs/versions using that inventory, never calls M03 Viewer/runtime. Root-provider completeness is separate from material resolution: missing M07 root=>Unknown blocks release/cleanup, not valid pinned install. Build ports/fakes independently after adoption, then providers in order below.
blocked_scope: Remove runtime construction cycle; do not weaken Unknown retention

finding: Precommit failure preservation does not cover postcommit root-transfer failure. H2 still expects ordinary successful projection or rejection.
proposed_exact_amendment: Common MutationReceipt {context,before_revision,after_revision,content_semantic,pin_id,result:Applied|NoChange|AppliedRetentionDeferred}. Once S1 commit occurred never ErrorUnchanged; retain Held/old+new union roots. M03 edit, M04 clear/undo, M06 merge/undo and M07 restore map tagged deferred result to real changed revision. No automatic rollback after publication.

source_fields: M06 ProjectCopyStoragePort directory rename / IO file_commit.rs decode f[1]!=target
finding: New-project copy stages M05 FileCommit catalog then renames directory; existing journal embeds canonical target path and rejects changed target. Rebinding a handle alone cannot fix journal.
proposed_exact_amendment: Recommended A: exclusive create FINAL directory with authenticated QuarantinedCopy marker; all child/catalog commits use final stable canonical path. Project is not selectable/openable until M01 durable Ready marker commit verified. All official M01 project-open/selection paths reject quarantine (including restart). No rename of any directory containing FileCommit journals. Failed copy retains quarantined diagnostics; no recursive delete. Alternative B publish journal-free initial tree then first index commit at final path requires separate initial-publication receipt and larger schema scope; not recommended here. Never edit/move IO journal to repair.
blocked_scope: New-project copy blocked REPLAN_REQUIRED until new M01/M06 publication protocol adopted

finding: Self-contained verified bundle can remain forever unavailable if original project catalog/root transfer proof inaccessible after relocation/loss.
proposed_exact_amendment: Separate LocalIntegrityReady from PublicationAcknowledged. Verified recovery index+payload+ALL asset copies permits explicit restore to authorized new destination even if SOURCE root transfer is pending; label SourceRetentionDeferred, retain original Held/Unknown, no original S1 Published/ACK. Destination import+pin+owner commit still mandatory. Missing/corrupt local bundle always blocks restore. Do not claim source retention proof merely from local readability.
blocked_scope: Restore readiness UI and recovery evidence state machine

finding: Holding source fences is stated but provider handles and source writer coordination are not in exact Store3trait envelope; naive final check races.
proposed_exact_amendment: Add application SourceReadReservation trait validate()->Result<SourceSnapshotId> with lifetime guard; definition/design providers acquire held native read fences compatible with their existing exclusive write protocol BEFORE generation active writer. Approval evidence uses immutable Approved revision plus HOST source-epoch reservation; no domain OS dependency or SPEC source mutation. Add proposed Ports generation_sources.rs, adapter generation_sources.rs/tests and existing M01 dispatch/M04 document_owner provider hooks as explicit child envelope delta; if full writer coverage cannot be proven return DependencyNotReady. Store3traits remain unchanged.
blocked_scope: M02 activation blocked until exact provider-fence envelope/Skeleton accepted

finding: New journal-read helper is necessary but must not turn arbitrary metadata read into recovery approval or share files incompatibly.
proposed_exact_amendment: IO-owned crate-private read guard constructed only after OS shared lock on exact canonical FileCommit sidecar; readonly inspect under that guard validates normalized target/journal terminal state/target raw digest. Generic caller cannot forge guard or clear journal. Signature and native alias/access matrix refined in IO child packet before Skeleton; public FileCommitPort unchanged. Definition-source read coordination treated separate declared consumer, not silently widened active-only helper.
blocked_scope: Only new readonly integration, accepted IO implementation not reopened

finding: M04 blocks edits during formal WriteInFlight; M07 allows newer edits during immutable snapshot publication. These are different reservations, not one global saving state.
proposed_exact_amendment: FormalWriteReservation blocks same-owner content mutations until matching commit completion. RecoveryAttemptReservation blocks only another recovery attempt and unstable capture; after pinned immutable capture, ordinary healthy owner edits may proceed. Shared M05 catalog short transitions do not create global document mutation lock. Both reserve per-target IO as needed; no OS locks held during owner callbacks.
blocked_scope: Common owner reservation model/late ACK tests

source_fields: M04 lossless XML inspection/closed clear / M06 typed merge
finding: Lossless XML inventory is not an adopted full entity/binding merge projector. C1 JSON cannot validate ESS XML or define every merge field.
proposed_exact_amendment: Inspection may preserve unknown XML. Clear/merge/install require complete format-specific projector; unsupported fields hard-block affected mutation with exact paths. Freeze typed node/edge/parent/binding mapping before M06 Skeleton; no generic recursive ID rewrite, no label guessing. FreshImportedIds only on explicit confirmed preview; no identity changes hidden under codec.
blocked_scope: M06 actual merge and ESS clear/import typed semantics; not plain readonly inspection

source_fields: errors and result tags across packages

proposed_exact_amendment: AuthenticatedExternalProof is server-owned immutable record with issuer module, operation kind, exact context, raw byte/receipt evidence and target identity; callers pass opaque receipt ID and service resolves in trusted registry or revalidates durable owner record. Never trust UI-copied receipt/complete bool. On restart missing owner record=>Unverified/DependencyNotReady; no fabricated ACK. Result phase codes below normalized, original module reason fields retained.
blocked_scope: All cross-owner proof constructors/IPC error DTOs

finding: Multiple packets name same pending owner modules and shared composition files; union is not blanket authority.

Proposed overlay adds source-fence child and replaces M01 copy rename protocol only after Owner adopts. Rebaseline all already-dirty product paths before each Skeleton slice. Old packet hashes remain immutable; regenerated module revision must point central overlay before gate acceptance.
blocked_scope: Shared-file work scheduling, all future Skeletons
